request.style: English, traditional gospel, rich soulful female lead with full gospel choir, Hammond organ, piano, bass, drums, hand claps, steady and assuring, 76 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I have made the LORD my refuge, the Most High my dwelling place
Through the snare and through the sickness I am sheltered by his grace
A thousand fall beside me and ten thousand at my right
But it will not come near me, for I'm hidden in his sight

[Chorus]
He will cover you with his pinions
And under his wings you will find refuge
His faithfulness is your shield and rampart
Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High
Will rest in the shadow of the Almighty

[Verse]
I won't fear the terror of the night or arrows in the day
He will command his angels to guard me in all my way
They will lift me in their hands so my foot won't strike a stone
I will tread upon the lion and the cobra, not alone

[Chorus]
He will cover you with his pinions
And under his wings you will find refuge
His faithfulness is your shield and rampart
Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High
Will rest in the shadow of the Almighty

[Bridge]
Because he clings to me in love, I will rescue him
He will call on me, and I will answer him
I will be with him in trouble
With long life I will satisfy him
And I will show him my salvation

[Outro]
Under his wings you will find refuge
Under his wings
